title: Fix the palette jump to a nested label
notes: Seen red on its mutant: the file's --selftest runs each door check clean and on a mutated copy of the source (par-palettemac.py:592-624) and prints 'MUTANTS | <check> | green | ... | red | en' per check and language, ending 'doors-nav: N checks x 2 languages, 0 problems'. The source mutant above is the real break (the jump door no longer reveals the parents); the case's regex (:441) goes red on it. Pass lines exist per case in this check (check name + 'pass'), but the check's opening MUTANTS list does not print the word pass, so the pass regex is not fooled by it. Built on lane/gap-keys (checks/parity/par-palettemac.py): the copy's language is pinned to English through mac-settings-general.appearance.language.en when it reads 'system' and put back after (the __main__ block), so the 12 catalogue-word cases are judged; c_label_parents_driven (case label-jump-opens-the-folded-parents-driven) folds the top parent with the Left key on the sidebar, clicks the palette jump to the depth-3 label, then reads mac-main.sidebar.labels (every parent open, label visible) and the selection; it is in the selftest on a stand-in (green clean, red on its mutant, en and fr: 'doors-nav: 13 checks x 2 languages, 0 problems'). Unrun on the app: the case needs Left on the focused label to fold it (SidebarState.labelLeft); if the fold does not happen the case says 'not judged' with the reason, never green.
